scope: Fees for Cash App for Business payments and for moving money out. Personal sending, Bitcoin, stocks and paper money deposits are out of scope.
structure: Personal accounts: sending from the Cash App balance or a debit card is free; sending money funded by a linked credit card costs the sender 3% of the amount (the ToS lists this both as 'Send from credit card 3%' and 'Add money from Credit Card: 3%'); receiving money is free. Standard transfers out to a linked bank/card are free (1–3 business days); Instant Transfer costs 0.5%–2.5% of the amount with a minimum fee of $0.25–$1 and a maximum of $75, with the exact rate only disclosed in-app before confirming. Business accounts: Cash App deducts 2.6% + $0.15 from each payment received from a customer's Cash App account and 3% from each Tap to Pay payment, so the balance credited already nets out the fee. For percentage fees Cash App uses banker's rounding to the penny (numbers ending in 5 round to the nearest even), and fees are deducted first from the collected funds; on a refund Cash App also refunds its fee so the customer gets the full amount back.
quotes: | Sending money using your Cash App Balance or debit card in the U.S. | $0 |

The specific fee amount is disclosed at the time of the transaction. | 0.5%-2.5% ($0.25-$1 min)** (the maximum fee shall not exceed $75)** |
**For these fees, Cash App uses banker’s rounding to round up or down to the penny, as applicable. Banker’s rounding rounds numbers ending in 5 to the nearest even integer.

Send from Credit Card: 3.00%**

There are currently no fees for sending funds using the Peer-to-Peer Service unless you are sending funds using a credit card. The fee for sending funds using a credit card for the Peer-to-Peer Service will be displayed at the time of the transaction.

Once you have a Cash App Business Account you will be able to accept payments from Cash App customers for the sale of goods and services, and we may charge you a transaction processing fee for doing so. This fee will be disclosed to you when you open, use, or switch to a Cash App Business Account. Payments you receive, less the applicable fee, will be deposited to your Cash App Balance.
Standard transfers are free and usually arrive within 1–3 business days

Instant transfers typically arrive immediately to your linked debit card and are subject to a 0.5%–2.5% fee (minimum $0.25–$1, maximum $75). This fee will be displayed before you complete the transaction
Cash App Business accounts are free to create and require no additional hardware to process business payments.
A 2.6% + $0.15 processing fee on each payment you receive from your customer’s Cash App account to your Cash App Business account
A 3% processing fee for each payment accepted via Tap to Pay
When you receive a payment from a customer on your Cash App Business account, the amount you receive in your balance will already have these fees deducted.

All Fees are charged at the time we process a transaction and are deducted first from the transferred or collected funds, unless otherwise disclosed. To the extent that the Fees are calculated as a percentage of the transaction amount, then we will use banker’s rounding to round up or down to the penny, as applicable. Banker’s rounding rounds numbers ending in 5 to the nearest even integer.
The fees are also refunded by the Company, so the full purchase amount is always returned to your customer.
excluded: ATM withdrawal fee ($2.50, waivable), foreign transaction fee (3%), paper money deposit ($1)
Cash App Card / Debit Flex Card fees (expedited shipping $15, replacement $5 / $50) and Cash App Tag fees (up to $250; $15 expedited shipping)
Bitcoin and stock investing fees, Afterpay, Cash App Lending, overdraft
Chargebacks (Business Terms reserve the right to charge a mediation fee; no amount stated)
notes: Instant Transfer is a published RANGE (0.5%–2.5%, minimum $0.25–$1, maximum $75); the exact percentage is only shown in-app before confirming, so a calculator can only bound the fee (e.g. show the 0.5% and 2.5% cases) or take the rate as an input.

The ToS lists the credit-card charge twice with different labels — 'Send from credit card 3%' (Prepaid Account fee table and P2P section) and 'Add money from Credit Card: 3%' (Details About Your Cash App Balance) — both 3% and both subject to banker's rounding.

Cash App Business 'Tap to Pay' is stated as a flat 3% with no fixed component, versus 2.6% + $0.15 for payments from a customer's Cash App account; no base definition beyond 'each payment you receive' is given (tips/tax not addressed).

Cash App Pay acceptance by merchants is priced by the merchant's processor, not by Cash App: Square's legacy list shows Cash App Pay at 2.6% + 15¢ (card-present) / 3.3% + 30¢ (card-not-present) and Stripe lists Cash App Pay at 2.9% + 30¢ — those are Square/Stripe pages, not cash.app pages.

cash.app help pages are JavaScript-rendered (plain HTTP returns an empty body); cash.app/cardfees returned HTTP 405 in both plain and browser fetches; cash.app/send rendered only a cookie banner. The ToS contains the same fee disclosures, so nothing is missing.
Cash App Business Terms specify fees are deducted first from collected funds and that Cash App refunds its fee when the business refunds a customer.
Search-engine snippets returned an older '0.5%–1.75%' instant-transfer range; the loaded pages say 0.5%–2.5%, and only the loaded pages were used.
Cash App states it uses banker's rounding to the penny; this calculator rounds half up, which can differ by one cent at exact half-cents.
summary: Cash App for Business deducts 2.6% + 15¢ from payments customers send you (3% for Tap to Pay). Instant transfers to a bank cost 0.5% to 2.5% with a 25¢ to $1 minimum and $75 maximum — Cash App shows the exact rate before you confirm. Standard transfers are free.
